tasks.name: filtered_affine_accumulation
tasks.definitions:
def accumulateSelected (cutoff coefficient : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], accumulator => accumulator
  | value :: remaining, accumulator =>
      if value < cutoff then
        accumulateSelected cutoff coefficient remaining ((coefficient * value + 1) :: accumulator)
      else accumulateSelected cutoff coefficient remaining accumulator
tasks.statement:
(cutoff coefficient : Nat) (values : List Nat) :
  accumulateSelected cutoff coefficient values [] =
    ((values.filter (fun value => value < cutoff)).map (fun value => coefficient * value + 1)).reverse
public_tactics:
induction values with
| nil => rfl
| cons value remaining ih => simp_all [accumulateSelected]; split <;> simp_all

have invariant : ∀ (remaining accumulator : List Nat),
    accumulateSelected cutoff coefficient remaining accumulator =
      ((remaining.filter (fun value => value < cutoff)).map (fun value => coefficient * value + 1)).reverse ++ accumulator := by
  intro remaining
  induction remaining with
  | nil => intro accumulator; rfl
  | cons value remaining ih =>
    intro accumulator
    by_cases selected : value < cutoff <;> simp_all [accumulateSelected, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]
simpa using invariant values []

tasks.name: depth_dependent_tree_traversal
tasks.definitions:
inductive WeightedTree where
  | leaf : Nat → WeightedTree
  | branch : WeightedTree → WeightedTree → WeightedTree

def collectValues : WeightedTree → Nat → List Nat
  | .leaf value, depth => [depth + 3 * value]
  | .branch left right, depth => collectValues left (depth + 1) ++ collectValues right (depth + 2)

def collectAccumulated : WeightedTree → Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | .leaf value, depth, accumulator => (depth + 3 * value) :: accumulator
  | .branch left right, depth, accumulator =>
      collectAccumulated right (depth + 2) (collectAccumulated left (depth + 1) accumulator)
tasks.statement:
(tree : WeightedTree) (depth : Nat) :
  collectAccumulated tree depth [] = (collectValues tree depth).reverse
public_tactics: induction tree generalizing depth <;> simp_all [collectAccumulated, collectValues, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc]

tasks.name: affine_second_order_recurrence
tasks.definitions:
def recurrenceState (a b c : Int) : Nat → Int × Int
  | 0 => (2, 1)
  | n + 1 => let previous := recurrenceState a b c n
             (a * previous.1 + b * previous.2 + c, previous.1)

def recurrenceValue (a b c : Int) : Nat → Int
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => 2
  | n + 2 => a * recurrenceValue a b c (n + 1) + b * recurrenceValue a b c n + c
tasks.statement:
(a b c : Int) (n : Nat) :
  (recurrenceState a b c n).1 = recurrenceValue a b c (n + 1)
public_tactics:
induction n with
| zero => rfl
| succ n ih => simp_all [recurrenceState, recurrenceValue]

tasks.name: commuting_iteration
tasks.definitions:
def repeatOperation (operation : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, value => value
  | count + 1, value => operation (repeatOperation operation count value)
tasks.statement:
(first second : Nat → Nat)
  (commute : ∀ value, first (second value) = second (first value))
  (m n value : Nat) :
  repeatOperation first m (repeatOperation second n value) =
    repeatOperation second n (repeatOperation first m value)
public_tactics:
have representation : ∀ (operation : Nat → Nat) (count value : Nat),
    repeatOperation operation count value = (operation^[count]) value := by
  intro operation count
  induction count with
  | zero => intro value; rfl
  | succ count ih => intro value; simp [repeatOperation, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
simp only [representation]
exact ((show Function.Commute first second from commute).iterate_left m |>.iterate_right n) value

tasks.name: linear_tree_evaluation
tasks.definitions:
inductive EvaluationTree where
  | leaf : Int → EvaluationTree
  | branch : EvaluationTree → EvaluationTree → EvaluationTree

def evaluateTree : EvaluationTree → Int → Int
  | .leaf coefficient, value => coefficient * value
  | .branch left right, value => 2 * evaluateTree left value - 3 * evaluateTree right value
tasks.statement:
(tree : EvaluationTree) (first second : Int) :
  evaluateTree tree (first + second) = evaluateTree tree first + evaluateTree tree second
